name: Darwin Precisions Corporation
summary: Darwin Precisions Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, assembles, processes, and trades in backlight modules, computer peripherals, and communication equipment in Taiwan, Korea, Japan, China, and internationally. The company offers system integration products for monitor, mobility, healthcare, retail, and education and enterprise applications, as well as offers optoelectronics products.
